title: VCPS project risk profile
description: Structural schema for .vcps/risk-model.md frontmatter. Owned in content by standard/risk-model.md (dimensions D1-D9, VCPS-RISK-010/020/021) and templates/contract.md ('risk-model.md has project and optional component profiles with all D1-D9 ratings, paths, and evidence references'). NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06; see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

profiles.description: Exactly one profile MUST have scope PROJECT; at most one profile per named component (templates/validation.md item 4).

impact_paths.description: VCPS-RISK-010: required (non-empty) when rating > 0, cited as E1 STATIC evidence or stronger.

evidence_gap.description: True when this rating has only E0 CLAIMED support (VCPS-RISK-010): the rating MUST then be treated as the higher candidate value until resolved.

scope.description: 'PROJECT' for the single project-wide profile, or a component identifier for a per-component profile (VCPS-RISK-021).

derived_level.description: Derived exactly per VCPS-RISK-020 from the dimension ratings above. project.yaml.level.value MUST match this for the PROJECT-scope profile.

shared_path_elevation.description: VCPS-RISK-021: true when this (otherwise lower-level) component is treated at the project's higher level because it shares a database/credential/deploy unit with a higher-level component.

approval_ref.description: Required (non-null) when this entry lowers the level (VCPS-RISK-022, HC-09).
